title: TRICARE Prime Amounts Credited When a TRICARE Select Line Is Reprocessed for the Catastrophic Cap
content:
TRICARE Prime enrollment, claim and fee records count toward the **TRICARE Select** family catastrophic total of a cap-reprocessed line where the beneficiary moved from Prime to Select during the plan year.

**Provision.** Where the beneficiary changed from TRICARE Prime to this Select enrollment during the plan year (the Prime enrollment ended by the beneficiary's own choice on the day before Select took effect), the amounts already credited toward the Prime catastrophic cap are credited to the family catastrophic total of a cap-reprocessed line. Within this rule's scope the beneficiary's only Prime enrollment took effect in the plan year, so every Prime record belongs to that calendar plan year, and the Prime amounts are: the cost shares on the beneficiary's Prime claim lines other than point-of-service charges, less the cost shares withdrawn by Prime reversals, plus the Prime enrollment fees paid toward the Prime installments whose coverage period has begun (the Prime payments posted, never more than those installments, payments being applied oldest first). Where those Prime amounts reach the tier's family catastrophic cap, the cap itself is credited; where the beneficiary changed from Prime in that way and they fall short of it, those Prime amounts are credited; otherwise nothing is credited from Prime. Point-of-service charges, premium-based plan costs and amounts a nonparticipating provider bills above the allowed amount never count toward the total.

## Points of judgement

- **Was there a change from Prime?** Only where the TRICARE Prime enrollment shows a voluntary disenrollment whose last day is the day before the Select effective date.
- **What is added up?** Prime claim-line cost shares other than point-of-service charges, less cost shares withdrawn by Prime reversals, plus Prime fee payments up to the Prime installments whose coverage period has begun.
- **Ceiling.** Never more than the tier's cap: 1000.00 for the TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A tiers, 1252.00 for the Group B tiers, 3000.00 for TRICARE Select Retiree Group A and 4034.00 for TRICARE Select Retiree Group B.

## Hypothetical credit (TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, cap 4034.00)

Prime ended voluntarily on 2026-02-28, Select effective 2026-03-01. Prime cost shares 1500.00 with no point-of-service charges, no reversals; Prime installments begun 400.00, Prime payments 450.00. Prime amounts: 1500.00 plus 400.00, that is 1900.00, below the cap, so 1900.00 is credited.
